title: [spec-gap][R-ADR-016] Root-side central collision optimizer using density map absent (appendix 7.6)
description: spec/appendix-design-rationale.md:418: Root (Rust gateway/rpl) runs central optimizer: minimize collisions using density map. No such code exists: rg optimiz in rust/ hits only low-data-rate airtime optimization (rust/lichen-core/src/airtime.rs:86-111); density_map/DensityMap zero hits repo-wide; rust/lichen-gateway contains no density logic. Closest capabilities: GCP channel_map publication (rust/lichen-gateway/src/resources.rs:1173) publishes a plan with no minimization; python sim models collisions (python/src/lichen/sim/medium.py:162) but has no optimizer. Found during appendix-design-rationale sweep. Suggested: implement a root-side planner in lichen-gateway/lichen-rpl consuming DIO-reported density, or amend the appendix to mark this aspirational.
